combat.hint: Fresh tracks in the mud. Something hunts along the water.

combat.hint: Branches rustle where there is no wind.

combat.name: Wolf Trail
combat.hint: Howling close by. A fight is certain.

combat.name: Overgrown Road
combat.hint: Arrows stuck in the trees. Someone guards this road.

merchant.name: Travelling Merchant
merchant.hint: A cart with a lantern. Gold can buy help here.

merchant.name: Trapper's Stall
merchant.hint: Herbs and tonics traded for coin.

rest.name: Quiet Glade
rest.hint: Soft moss and clean water. A place to recover.

rest.name: Hollow Oak
rest.hint: A dry shelter inside a giant tree.

treasure.hint: Nobody has lived here for years. Maybe something was left behind.

treasure.name: Fallen Cart
treasure.hint: An overturned cart half-buried in leaves.

story.hint: Cold ashes and a familiar knot in the rope. Father was here?

story.name: Carved Stone
story.hint: Marks cut into a stone by a careful hand.

story.name: Ranger's Hut
story.hint: Someone who remembers travellers lives here.

class.hint: An old man practises forms outside his hut.

class.hint: Hunters test newcomers with bow and blade.
